description: Make a short video when someone asks for a clip, a video or an animation, and call it before you say so.

offer.reason: offered only to an adult on their own written screen, when the household has video on and the Stack has a video model

author: MaiPai

examples: make a short video of a paper boat in the rain
can you generate a video of a dragon flying over a castle
make a clip of waves on a beach at sunset
turn that picture into a video
create a short animation of a robot waving hello

prompt.description: What the video shows, written as a full description in plain English: the subject, what moves, the setting and the light or mood, built from what the person asked for. For a picture that moves, describe the motion. Keep their own words for names. Do not add people, objects or themes they did not ask for. A video exists only if you called this tool in this reply: never say one is being made, ready or on its way without calling it, and never describe a clip you did not make.

from_picture.description: Optional. Set to "latest" only when the person asks to animate or bring to life a picture that was made earlier in this chat. Set to "attached" only when the person attached one photo of an adult in this household to this message and asks to animate it, and also set photo_subject. Leave it out for a video from words alone. A photo of anyone else cannot be animated.

photo_subject.description: Only with from_picture "attached": the name of the adult in this household who is in the attached photo, exactly as the person said it, or "me" when they say it is themselves. Never guess a name; if they did not say, ask them who it is.

orientation.description: Optional shape of the video. landscape is the default. Use portrait only for a phone-style tall video when the person asks.

seconds.description: Optional length in seconds, 1 to 10. Leave it out for 5. A video longer than 5 seconds is made Detailed automatically.

quality.description: Optional. Leave it out for almost every request: Home then uses the household's setting. Use detailed when the person wants the people in the video to talk or speak words, wants sound, music or a sound track, wants it longer than 5 seconds, or wants a custom look; it makes a sound track and speech and starts from words only. Use quick when they want it to start from a picture, or ask for a silent one. When you choose detailed, say so in one short sentence. Spoken words are clearest in a clip of 5 seconds or less, so for a spoken line keep seconds at 5 unless the person asks for longer.

style.description: Optional. The name of one of the household's saved video styles, only when the person names it. Leave it out otherwise; never invent one.

depicts_real_person.description: Set true when the person asks for a video that shows a real, named or identifiable person (a celebrity, a politician, someone they know). Home makes one only of an adult in this household who agreed, through their saved style or an attached photo. Otherwise leave it out.
